children: Dragonfly Energy entered into a Limited Waiver and Eighth Amendment to its senior secured term loan to address near-term liquidity and preferred dividend timing. The lenders waived testing of the minimum liquidity covenant for the month ended September 30, 2026, and waived any default related to deferring part of the October 1 cash dividend on the Series B preferred, subject to a revised payment schedule. In exchange, the company will pay a $450,000 amendment fee in kind, increasing the loan's outstanding principal. The amendments are intended to preserve flexibility while the company manages cash flows.
